options.name: -d
options.description: Be verbose (dry run) and display number of user processes

options.name: -e
options.description: Use the effective user ID instead of the real user ID for matching processes with -u

options.name: -I
options.description: Request confirmation before killing each process

options.name: -l
options.description: List the names of the available signals and exit

options.name: -m
options.description: Match the process name as a regular expression

options.name: -u
options.description: Limit potentially matching processes to those belonging to the user

options.name: -t
options.description: Limit matching processes to those running on the specified TTY

options.name: -c
options.description: Limit matching processes to those matching the given name

options.name: -q
options.description: Suppress error message if no processes are matched
